title: Yamaha RayZR 125 Fi Ubs 2020
description: Hi  I am Sandip Chakraborty   Welcome to our Youtube Channel Indian Bike    Namaskar Dosto, INDIAN BIKE ke is Episode mein maine aapse Yamaha RayZR 125 Fi Ubs 2020 ke vedios share ki hai, Mujhe umeed hai ki yea video aapko pasand aayega.   RayZR 125 Fi Specifications ENGINE Engine type Air cooled, 4-stroke, SOHC, 2-valve Displacement 125cc Bore & Stroke 52.4 X 57.9mm Compression ratio 10.2:1 Maximum horse power 6.0kW(8.2PS)/6500r/min Maximum torque 9.7N.m(1.0kgf.m)/5000r/min Stop & Start System (SSS) Equipped Smart Motor Generator (SMG) System Equipped Fuel system Fuel injection Starting system type Electric starter and kick starter Battery Maintenance free - 12V,5.0 Ah Ignition system TCI (Transistor Controlled Ignition) Transmission type V-belt automatic  DIMENSIONS Fuel tank capacity 5.2L Overall length 1,880mm Overall width 685mm Overall height 1,190mm Seat height 785mm Wheelbase 1,280mm Minimum ground clearance 145mm Kerb weight (with oil and a full fuel tank) 99kg Under-seat storage 21L  CHASSIS Suspension type (Front/Rear) Telescopic fork / Unit swing Tyre size (Front) 90/90-12 Tubeless Tyre size (Rear) 110/90-10 Tubeless UBS Equipped Brake type (Front) Disc 190mm / Drum Brake type (Rear) Drum Headlight 12V,35/35W x 1 Brake light / Tail light 12V,21/5W x 1 Position light LED Side stand engine cut-off switch Equipped  RayZR Ex-Showroom Price in West Bengal Rs 67 060* * Price may change without prior notice.   please dosto mere is channel ko   Share, Support, Subscribe!!  kijie.    About : INDIAN BIKE is a YouTube Channel, where you will find cars & Vehicles in hd quality video, New video is Posted Every week :)    www.youtube.com/INDIANBIKE  #YamahaRayZR125FiUbs2020 #yamaha #INDIANBIKE

asr.full_text: hello friends, I am Sandeep and you are watching your own channel Indian Bike and in this episode, I have brought a brand new Yamaha Cygnus RZR 125A5 scooter for you I am making this video in Murshidabad district, eastern auto, Yamaha showroom i made the video and this scooter is available here you are watching the video on a pure 4K you can see all the specs here these are this scooter then please comment and I shall tell. There are two variants to this scooter. One is with drum and the other one is dis-unified system. In Drum you will found this scooter in two colors. It would be available in both black and blue color Now coming to the drum We have a Metallic black color 125cc FI engine is included You will get 30% more power and 16% more mileage And you will get classic speedometer and not such in drum and this disc variant also have digital speedometer is present in the disc variant. Keep this thing with you to know. It is multifunction key present in this vehicle. This does all the work of that scooter. You get a smart motor generator. This vehicle has a stop and start engine system. The weight of the car is lightweight it has LED light in front 2 steps seat is available it has long seat so that it is comfortable to the passenger the stitching is also good it has the logo and red radar as you can see look at this great work finish the finishing is great and looks beautiful the car is small but has a amazing fuel resistant grab rail there is self start option on the top You also see the engine start to full You will also get the auto start option From this side you see the new design on the top Means its a very new avatar I personally will tell you that if you want to buy a Yamaha scooter in 2020, then go with the Zr Because I felt that the facie is big somewhere Meaning that the model is getting bigger and smaller Its size has increased even more with the new model but this size is more compact now and small. In city riding, the model is perfect for you. It is easy to ride and you don't have to think much that it is too small. These are the mufflers of the silencer its also plastic its very good finishing after watching this video you must visit the showroom If you buy this scooter Do visit here I think if you get a scooter compact design very small. You will find small, compact design very good scooter You will find nice headlight Telesccopic suspention 12 inch cast wheel front here you can see 12 inch cast wile in front is dish brake and at back is drum brake here multi function key switch so if we move like this seat will open after seat open you are getting 21 liter storage here you can keep helmet only you can keep a full face helmet without it Talking about accessories it also has a mobile charger They also have this option It gives you a reduced braking distance You are given with better handling Which will come to work during braking And you will get a smoother chassis behaviour during braking You are given a two level seat And it has 5 litre petrol storage Although mileage is not available for now but we hope it will gives us good mileage so friends i would say if you watch the video then please leave a like & i would request you to visit my showrooms if you want suggestions about my scooter don't forget to buy my scooter do visit on showroom before buying a fashino If you want my suggestions then go for it Always keep this in mind before buying any scooter you will need compact, small , Powerful and compact scooter I feel everything is in this model It has a lot of the features and a motorbike with a very Comptact design So this is all my friends Do subscribe my Channel Don't forget to Like & Comment I am with you always Thank you
